candidates.name: Follicular atrophoderma
support_spans: Several round atrophic lesions on his face, symmetric and bilateral, located especially on the malar and preauricular areas, with a diameter of 5 to 10 mm.
Histopathologic examination: Showed significant epidermal dell and superficial dermal lymphocytic infiltrate associated with dermal fibrosis
Orcein stain demonstrated reduction of elastic fibers in the dermis beneath the epidermal dell
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and histopathologic examination results are consistent with follicular atrophoderma, a rare skin disorder characterized by atrophic lesions and reduction of elastic fibers.
